nodes.description: Owner address of the DSAuth mixin; set in constructor and by setOwner, consulted by isAuthorized.
External DSAuthority contract used by isAuthorized for delegated permission checks.
Initializes owner to msg.sender and emits LogSetOwner.
Auth-guarded setter that overwrites the owner state variable.
Auth-guarded setter that overwrites the authority state variable.
Internal view returning whether src may call sig; compares against address(this), owner and authority.
Stored bytes32 oracle value read by peek/read and written by poke.
Validity flag for the stored value; set by poke, cleared by void, required by read.
Note + auth guarded function that stores a new value and marks it valid.
Public view returning the stored value and its validity flag without reverting.
Public view that requires has to be set and returns the stored value.
Note + auth guarded function that clears the validity flag of the stored value.
Authorisation mapping for the OSM; set to 1 for the deployer and managed via rely/deny.
Circuit breaker flag read by the stoppable modifier and written by stop/start/void.
Address of the DSValue source oracle that poke queries and change replaces.
Minimum delay between price updates in seconds; read by prev and pass, written by step.
Timestamp of the last successful storage update; written by poke, read by pass.
Current Feed struct (val, has) served by peek/read; rotated by poke and cleared by void.
Next Feed struct served by peep; promoted to cur on the subsequent poke.
Whitelist mapping of contracts allowed to read the feed via the toll modifier.
Grants ward to msg.sender and stores the initial DSValue source address.
Note + auth guarded function granting ward status to an address.
Note + auth guarded function revoking ward status from an address.
Note + auth guarded function that engages the stopped circuit breaker.
Note + auth guarded function that disengages the stopped circuit breaker.
Note + auth guarded function that replaces the DSValue source oracle.
Internal view returning block.timestamp as the OSM clock.
Rounds a timestamp down to the previous multiple of hop, reverting when hop is zero.
Auth guarded function that updates the hop delay, requiring a non-zero value.
Note + auth guarded emergency function clearing cur/nxt and engaging the breaker.
View predicate checking whether zzz + hop has elapsed relative to era().
Note + stoppable function that reads the DSValue source and rotates cur/nxt when the delay has passed.
Toll-guarded view returning the current value and validity.
Toll-guarded view returning the next value and validity.
Toll-guarded view returning the current value or reverting when unset.
Note + auth guarded function whitelisting a single contract for the toll modifier.
Note + auth guarded function removing a single contract from the whitelist.
Note + auth guarded batch variant whitelisting an array of contracts.
Note + auth guarded batch variant removing an array of contracts from the whitelist.
Internal safe add over uint64 used to compute zzz + hop in pass().
Caller supplied by the transaction; drives every auth/toll check and is recorded in logs.
Miner-controlled timestamp used by era(), pass(), prev() and poke().
Inline assembly in the note modifier performing calldatacopy and log4 with caller and raw calldata.
Inline assembly in the ds-note modifier reading calldataload(4), calldataload(36) and callvalue.
External call to an arbitrary, auth-controlled source contract inside poke; return values are trusted.
External call to the authority contract from isAuthorized; the target is always true and its result gates access.
Modifier that logs the call via an anonymous log4 assembly block.
Modifier that emits an anonymous LogNote event built from raw calldata.
Address parameter of OSM.rely that receives ward status.
Address parameter of OSM.deny whose ward status is revoked.
New DSValue source address assigned by OSM.change.
Timestamp argument rounded down by OSM.prev.
New hop delay supplied to OSM.step.
Single address whitelisted by OSM.kiss.
Array of addresses whitelisted by the batch OSM.kiss.
Single address removed by OSM.diss.
Array of addresses removed by the batch OSM.diss.
Local holding the bytes32 value returned by the DSValue peek call.
Local holding the validity flag returned by the DSValue peek call.
Bytes32 value stored by DSValue.poke.
New owner address assigned by setOwner.
New DSAuthority contract assigned by setAuthority.
Address being checked by isAuthorized.
Function selector being checked by isAuthorized.

edges.reason: DSAuth constructor assigns owner directly from msg.sender
Constructor writes the owner state variable
setOwner is guarded by the auth modifier which checks msg.sender
setOwner overwrites the owner state variable
setAuthority is guarded by the auth modifier which checks msg.sender
setAuthority overwrites the authority state variable
isAuthorized compares the source address against the stored owner
isAuthorized consults the authority contract for delegation
isAuthorized forwards the permission decision to authority.canCall
The auth modifier passes msg.sender and msg.sig into isAuthorized
LibNote note modifier records the caller in its log4 entry
DSNote note modifier emits LogNote with msg.sender as indexed topic
DSValue.poke is note + auth guarded, access gated on msg.sender
DSValue.void is note + auth guarded, access gated on msg.sender
poke stores the wut parameter into the value state variable
poke writes the val state variable
poke sets has to true after writing the value
void clears the has validity flag
peek returns the stored val
peek returns the stored has flag
read calls peek to obtain value and flag
read requires the has flag to be set before returning
OSM constructor grants ward status to msg.sender
Constructor writes the wards mapping
auth modifier of rely requires wards[msg.sender] == 1
rely writes wards[usr] = 1
auth modifier of deny requires wards[msg.sender] == 1
deny writes wards[usr] = 0
stop is auth guarded on msg.sender
stop sets the stopped flag to 1
start is auth guarded on msg.sender
start clears the stopped flag
change is auth guarded on msg.sender
change overwrites the src oracle address
step is auth guarded on msg.sender
step writes the hop delay
void is auth guarded on msg.sender
void resets cur to an empty Feed
void resets nxt to an empty Feed
void sets the stopped flag
prev reads hop as the rounding window
prev rounds the ts parameter down to a multiple of hop
era returns block.timestamp, the timestamp dependency of the contract
prev is invoked with era() inside poke
pass compares era() against zzz + hop
pass reads hop in the elapsed-time check
pass reads zzz in the elapsed-time check
pass computes add(zzz, hop) whose overflow is guarded only by a manual require
pass outcome depends on the miner-influenced block.timestamp
poke requires pass() to be true before updating
poke is gated on timestamp-derived pass() so it is timestamp dependent
poke writes the zzz update timestamp
poke overwrites cur with the previous nxt feed
poke reads and rewrites the nxt feed
poke reads src to construct the DSValue target
stoppable modifier of poke reads the stopped flag
poke performs an external DSValue(src).peek() call
External call re-enters the DSValue peek implementation
src is used as the target address of the external call
toll modifier of peek requires bud[msg.sender] == 1
peek access is gated on the caller whitelist
peek returns cur.val and cur.has
toll modifier of peep requires bud[msg.sender] == 1
peep access is gated on the caller whitelist
peep returns nxt.val and nxt.has
toll modifier of read requires bud[msg.sender] == 1
read access is gated on the caller whitelist
read returns cur.val when cur.has is set
kiss is auth guarded on msg.sender
kiss writes bud[a] = 1
diss is auth guarded on msg.sender
diss writes bud[a] = 0
batch kiss is auth guarded on msg.sender
batch kiss writes bud[a[i]] = 1 in a loop
batch diss is auth guarded on msg.sender
batch diss writes bud[a[i]] = 0 in a loop
rely stores the usr parameter into the ward mapping
deny clears the ward mapped to the usr parameter
change assigns the src_ parameter to the src state variable
step validates and stores the ts parameter into hop
kiss whitelists the single address parameter
batch kiss iterates over the address array parameter
diss de-whitelists the single address parameter
batch diss iterates over the address array parameter
poke local wut receives the external peek value and is cast into nxt
poke local ok controls whether the feed rotation occurs
setOwner assigns the owner_ parameter to the owner state variable
setAuthority assigns the authority_ parameter to the authority state variable
isAuthorized compares the src parameter against address(this) and owner
isAuthorized forwards the sig parameter to authority.canCall
DSValue.poke executes the DSNote assembly block through its note modifier
OSM.poke executes the LibNote note modifier
OSM.rely executes the LibNote note modifier
OSM.stop executes the LibNote note modifier
LibNote.note runs the inline assembly calldatacopy/log4 block
DSNote.note runs the inline assembly calldataload/callvalue block

normalization_plan.reason: The usr parameter only carries data into rely's ward mapping write; it has no independent semantic identity.
The usr parameter is only used to clear a ward entry inside deny.
The src_ parameter exists solely to be written into the src state variable by change.
The ts parameter is only consumed by the modulo computation inside prev.
The ts parameter is validated and then assigned to hop inside step.
The single address parameter is only used for the bud write in kiss.
The address array parameter is only iterated for bud writes in batch kiss.
The single address parameter is only used for the bud clear in diss.
The address array parameter is only iterated for bud clears in batch diss.
The wut local is an intermediate buffer for the external peek result inside poke.
The ok local is an intermediate flag controlling the rotation branch inside poke.
The wut parameter is immediately stored into the val state variable by poke.
The owner_ parameter is directly assigned to the owner state variable.
The authority_ parameter is directly assigned to the authority state variable.
The src parameter only participates in the authorization comparison inside isAuthorized.
The sig parameter is only forwarded to authority.canCall inside isAuthorized.
